records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Media set up
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Silver Media here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Silver Media* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Two Wrenfield emails (email:ceb5445c, email:ba32d764) drew no reply and no tickets filed, so no sign of engagement. Silence after onboarding nudges makes unaided activation in the remaining 8 days unlikely, though a Pro paid plan leaves some intent.

draft.subject: Getting Silver Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Checking in now that you've had Wrenfield for a week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is the quickest way to see how it fits Silver Media's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up -- or just reply here and I'll help by email.

Best,
Chidi
